newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Ahold sees full-yr net up 30-45 pct.
newsitem.headline: Ahold sees full-yr net up 30-45 pct.

text.p: Dutch supermarkets group Koninklijke Ahold NV said on Tuesday it expected its 1997 full-year net profit to increase by 30 to 45 percent and earnings per share by between 12 and 20 percent.
Earlier today, Ahold said it saw considerable profit growth in the current year and significantly higher earnings per share.
"This boils down to an increase of 30 to 45 percent in net profits and a 12 to 20 percent growth in earnings per share," chairman Cees van der Hoeven told reporters.
He added the expected profit rise was not including positive effects of currency rates which were considerable at this moment.
Last year, Ahold posted a net profit of 632.4 million guilders or 4.30 guilders per share.
